Data extraction: PSV (pipe-separated values) rows as Sequence nodes

```csharp title="C#"

using TreeSitterLanguagePack;

var result = TreeSitterLanguagePackConverter.Process("a|b|c\n1|2|3\n", new ProcessConfig { DataExtraction = true, Language = "psv" });
Console.WriteLine(result.Data);
Console.WriteLine(result.Data!.Kind);
Console.WriteLine(result.Data!.Children);
```
